proposal.chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation using Pd(OH)2/Al2O3. Batch yield was low (38%) likely due to poor gas-liquid mass transfer. Flow design uses segmented flow (Taylor flow) to enhance kLa. Acetic acid included to protonate amine intermediate and prevent catalyst poisoning. Catalyst is heterogeneous; requires filtration. No light source needed.

batch_record.reaction_description: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol was dissolved in methanol and contacted with hydrogen over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C in a batch hydrogenation reactor for 5 h. Acetic acid may be used to enhance the reaction rate. The 3-azetidinol product was obtained in 38.1% yield.
